blocks.text: The SWINEnovation, located at the Excelsior Farms corporate office, officially reopened its doors last July 9, 2026. Originally established in late 2018, the facility underwent a comprehensive technological revamp through a joint partnership between local operator Excelsior Farms Inc. and global agribusiness leaders Cargill, PIC, and Alltech. The collaborative facility serves as a free educational space designed to teach modern, scientific livestock management to small-scale backyard raisers, agricultural students, and industry stakeholders. The relaunch ceremony, which coincided with the 12th anniversary of Excelsior Farms, brought together prominent executives from across the agricultural sector to seal the alliance.
